explication: 9Router is a local AI gateway and dashboard that connects coding clients to many model providers. The principal workflow is: a CLI sends an OpenAI-compatible request, the gateway optionally compresses tool output, translates formats, selects providers or fallbacks, executes the request, and streams a normalized result back. The dashboard configures provider connections, models, OAuth, quotas, tunnels, and CLI integrations. The graph preserves documented media and MITM capabilities; gateway internals are inferred from the documented tree and sampled modules, so some wiring remains intentionally omitted.
